claims.text: Many reviewers find the cream effective for diaper rash, pressure sores, and chafed or sensitive skin.
Reviewers frequently praise the thinner, non-greasy consistency that absorbs quickly and is easy to spread.
Some reviewers note the thinner consistency can come off more easily and may not work as well as thicker creams.
Several reviewers say it works as well as or better than name-brand barrier creams.
A few reviewers mention it lacks zinc or seems less effective than other dimethicone products.
